subject.title: fix(sessions): stop cap enforcement from deleting every removable entry

question: Should OpenClaw retain a fixed bounded newest-removable floor when protected session entries already meet a configured positive cap, rather than preserve the prior delete-all-removable behavior?
rationale: This is a deliberate upgrade-sensitive retention-policy change; the current environment prevented validating the exact implementation and current-main history needed to resolve that policy choice automatically.

options.title: Confirm the bounded floor
options.body: Accept the 25-entry safety floor after a refreshed source review confirms the zero-cap, normal-cap, warning, and upgrade paths.

options.title: Choose a different policy
options.body: Direct a different documented behavior for an unsatisfiable positive cap, then update the helper and regression coverage to match it.

recommendation.title: Confirm the bounded floor
recommendation.body: Accept the 25-entry safety floor after a refreshed source review confirms the zero-cap, normal-cap, warning, and upgrade paths.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged work is the strongest supplied history signal for the session-maintenance and work-admission boundary.
